text: Notes:

1 The Negros Island Region (NIR) was abolished through Executive Order No. 38, "Revoking Executive Order NO. 183 (s. 2015) which created a Negros Island and for Other Purposes", signed by 
  President Rodrigo Roa Duterte on 07 August 2017. The abolition of NIR reverted the provinces, cities, municipalities, and barangays of Negros Occidental and City of Bacolod to Region VI (Western Visayas)  
  and Negros Oriental to Region VII (Central Visayas).
2 Renamed province from Compostela Valley under Republic Act No. 11297, dated April 17, 2019; ratified on December 7, 2019.
3 Renamed region from ARMM under Republic Act No.11054, dated July 27, 2018; ratified on January 25, 2019.
4 Excludes 10 barangays transferred to the City of Taguig, in accordance with the Supreme Court decision in General Register (G.R.) 235316 dated 01 December 2021.
5 Includes 10 barangays transferred from the City of Makati, in accordance with the Supreme Court decision in GR 235316 dated 01 December 2021.
6 Re-established into a region under Republic Act (RA) No. 12000 dated 11 June 2024.
7 Transferred province under RA No. 12000; taken from Region VI - Western Visayas.
8 Transferred province under RA No. 12000; taken from Region VII - Central Visayas.
9 Created into a province through the division of the Province of Maguindanao under RA No. 11550; ratified on 17 September 2022.
10 Renamed from Interim Province; comprised of eight newly created municipalities under the Bangsamoro Autonomy Act Nos. 41 to 48 dated 15 September 2022; ratified on 13 April 2024.
